title: Choose the homepage’s visual world
question: Which world should shape a public portfolio built around financial tools, GitHub activity, and a flagship app?

options.label: Security Printer’s Proof
options.thesis: Your work appears as verifiable layers of craft: source activity, one flagship financial instrument, and public writing registered into a single proof.
options.viewport: A navigation registration strip crosses a cool engraved field; the developer/finance thesis anchors the left, GitHub activity forms a living proof lattice on the right, and the featured financial app begins as a numbered lower band.
options.risk: It can resemble a bank or crypto launch if proof marks become decoration instead of evidence.

raised.raise: Hierarchy is carried by depth and brightness before any container is introduced.
Section changes land as decisive whole-frame transitions rather than scattered effects.
Activity numbers gain kinetic emphasis only when the underlying work changes.
Every section retains visible provenance from one continuous source sheet.
GitHub history accumulates as a visible construction record, not a static badge.

options.label: Analyst’s Working Paper
options.lineage: research workbooks and annotated model printouts
options.thesis: The homepage reads like a working thesis backed by inspectable code, project evidence, and margin notes rather than a finished sales deck.
options.viewport: A concise working memo opens with the developer/finance thesis, a marked-up flagship-app figure, and a narrow GitHub evidence column; navigation behaves like workbook tabs.
options.risk: This is the most naturally legible direction, but it can collapse into a familiar fintech dashboard if the working evidence is too tidy.

options.label: Instrument Display
options.lineage: seven-segment clocks, price totems, and scoreboards
options.thesis: Projects and activity occupy fixed cells whose state changes in place, turning the homepage into a public instrument panel.
options.viewport: A monumental segmented statement sits above mode-button navigation, a synchronized GitHub cell bank, and the featured financial app treated as the primary instrument.
options.case: It strongly identifies finance and software as measurable systems, but loses to the proof sheet on prose and broad-public readability.
options.risk: Long-form writing, résumé detail, and nuanced project stories can feel forced inside rigid cells.

options.label: Cracktro Queue
options.lineage: bitmap title screens and layered demo-scene scrollers
options.thesis: GitHub events, posts, and projects move through one luminous depth-ranked queue.
options.viewport: An ivory developer/finance statement holds still while activity planes drift behind it and the featured project pulls into focus.
options.case: It speaks vividly to developer culture but narrows the public finance audience and obscures the project story.
options.risk: The portfolio could read as retro-computing fandom before it reads as financial-tool expertise.
options.kept: Depth and brightness can establish hierarchy without boxing every item.

options.label: Rebel Menu
options.lineage: torn-paper game menus and full-frame poster splashes
options.thesis: Every portfolio section arrives as a forceful full-screen selection rather than a polite scroll target.
options.viewport: A scarlet frame launches the visitor through angled navigation shards toward the featured financial app.
options.case: The navigation is memorable, but the cultural signal fights the measured credibility of financial tools and broadens no product truth.
options.risk: The visual attitude can overpower the work and make finance content feel promotional.
options.kept: A transition should commit the whole frame, not sprinkle unrelated hover effects.

options.label: Bolted Futurist Book
options.lineage: machine-bound futurist books and kinetic wood type
options.thesis: Code activity and market ideas collide as typographic events bolted into one fast mechanical volume.
options.viewport: An angled developer/finance declaration slams across a bolted spread, with GitHub events and the flagship app entering as typographic pressure points.
options.case: It expresses speed and making, but weakens scanability and the calm trust needed for financial-tool proof.
options.risk: The kinetic composition can turn substantive work into spectacle.
options.kept: Numbers and activity labels may change weight and angle when their underlying state changes.

options.label: Orizuru Sequence
options.lineage: a single washi sheet transformed through recoverable folds
options.thesis: One continuous surface unfolds from identity to code activity, project anatomy, writing, and contact.
options.viewport: A folded red plane opens into the developer/finance thesis while numbered creases preview the routes through work and writing.
options.case: The continuous transformation is elegant, but the cultural connection to financial development is too indirect for a first encounter.
options.risk: Visitors may remember the folding metaphor and not the work it was meant to reveal.
options.kept: Sections should preserve visible provenance as parts of one authored system.

options.label: Coiled Work Tower
options.lineage: monumental earthen towers built course by course
options.thesis: The portfolio rises as a cumulative record of commits, shipped tools, essays, and durable expertise.
options.viewport: A vertical construction record rises through the screen, with the current GitHub course and featured app embedded as structural milestones.
options.case: Accumulation maps honestly to a career, but the hand-built material does not identify finance or software quickly enough.
options.risk: The earthy metaphor can imply craft lifestyle before technical precision.
options.kept: Activity should accumulate into a visible construction record rather than appear as a decorative badge.

canonCard.label: Polished Portfolio Grid
canonCard.thesis: A direct introduction, featured-project card, GitHub activity panel, article list, and conventional contact close executed at high craft.
canonCard.viewport: A familiar top navigation frames a concise introduction and primary explore-work action, followed by the financial app and GitHub activity in orderly cards.
canonCard.risk: It is immediately understandable but intentionally similar to countless developer portfolios.
